---
title: "Docker Compose"
description: "Sandbox with Docker Compose for multi-container apps"
---

## Install Docker and Compose

Install Docker Engine and whichever Compose command is available on the distro (`docker compose` plugin or `docker-compose` binary).

<CodeGroup>
```typescript JavaScript & TypeScript
// template.ts
import { Template } from 'e2b'

export const template = Template()
  .fromUbuntuImage('24.04')
  .runCmd([
    'set -euxo pipefail',
    'apt-get update',
    'DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg lsb-release docker.io',
    'DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker-compose-plugin || true',
    'DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker-compose-v2 || true',
    'DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker-compose || true',
    'docker --version',
    'docker compose version || docker-compose --version',
  ], { user: 'root' })
```

```python Python
# template.py
from e2b import Template

template = (
    Template()
    .from_ubuntu_image("24.04")
    .run_cmd(
        [
            "set -euxo pipefail",
            "apt-get update",
            "DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl gnupg lsb-release docker.io",
            "DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker-compose-plugin || true",
            "DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker-compose-v2 || true",
            "DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y docker-compose || true",
            "docker --version",
            "docker compose version || docker-compose --version",
        ],
        user="root",
    )
)
```
</CodeGroup>

## Build the template

Use at least 2 CPUs and 2 GB RAM for Docker workloads.

<CodeGroup>
```typescript JavaScript & TypeScript
// build.ts
import { Template, defaultBuildLogger } from 'e2b'
import { template as composeTemplate } from './template'

await Template.build(composeTemplate, 'docker-compose', {
  cpuCount: 2,
  memoryMB: 2048,
  onBuildLogs: defaultBuildLogger(),
})
```

```python Python
# build.py
from e2b import Template, default_build_logger
from template import template as compose_template

Template.build(compose_template, "docker-compose",
    cpu_count=2,
    memory_mb=2048,
    on_build_logs=default_build_logger(),
)
```
</CodeGroup>

## Run a Compose project

Create a sandbox from the template, ensure Docker daemon is ready, write a `compose.yaml`, and run the stack.

<CodeGroup>
```typescript JavaScript & TypeScript
// sandbox.ts
import { Sandbox } from 'e2b'

const sbx = await Sandbox.create('docker-compose')

await sbx.commands.run(`
set -euxo pipefail

if docker info >/tmp/docker-info.txt 2>&1; then
  echo "dockerd already ready"
  exit 0
fi

if [ -f /var/run/docker.pid ]; then
  pid="$(cat /var/run/docker.pid || true)"
  if [ -z "$pid" ] || ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -f /var/run/docker.pid
  fi
fi

if ! pgrep -x dockerd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nohup dockerd > /tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 &
fi

for i in $(seq 1 45); do
  docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0
  sleep 1
done

tail -n 200 /tmp/dockerd.log || true
exit 1
`, { user: 'root' })

await sbx.commands.run('mkdir -p /tmp/docker-compose-test', { user: 'root' })

await sbx.files.write('/tmp/docker-compose-test/compose.yaml', [
  'services:',
  '  hello:',
  '    image: busybox:1.36',
  '    command: ["sh", "-lc", "echo docker-compose-ok"]',
  '',
].join('\n'))

const result = await sbx.commands.run(`
set -euxo pipefail
cd /tmp/docker-compose-test

if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker compose up --abort-on-container-exit --remove-orphans
  docker compose down --remove-orphans -v
  echo "Docker Compose ran successfully"
elif docker-compose --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker-compose up --abort-on-container-exit --remove-orphans
  docker-compose down --remove-orphans -v
  echo "Docker Compose ran successfully"
else
  echo "No compose command available"
  exit 127
fi
`, { user: 'root', timeoutMs: 600_000 })

console.log(result.stdout)
await sbx.kill()
```

```python Python
# sandbox.py
from e2b import Sandbox

sbx = Sandbox.create("docker-compose")

sbx.commands.run(
    """
set -euxo pipefail

if docker info >/tmp/docker-info.txt 2>&1; then
  echo "dockerd already ready"
  exit 0
fi

if [ -f /var/run/docker.pid ]; then
  pid="$(cat /var/run/docker.pid || true)"
  if [ -z "$pid" ] || ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -f /var/run/docker.pid
  fi
fi

if ! pgrep -x dockerd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nohup dockerd > /tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 &
fi

for i in $(seq 1 45); do
  docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0
  sleep 1
done

tail -n 200 /tmp/dockerd.log || true
exit 1
    """,
    user="root",
)

sbx.commands.run("mkdir -p /tmp/docker-compose-test", user="root")

sbx.files.write(
    "/tmp/docker-compose-test/compose.yaml",
    """
services:
  hello:
    image: busybox:1.36
    command: ["sh", "-lc", "echo docker-compose-ok"]
""",
)

result = sbx.commands.run(
    """
set -euxo pipefail
cd /tmp/docker-compose-test

if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker compose up --abort-on-container-exit --remove-orphans
  docker compose down --remove-orphans -v
  echo "Docker Compose ran successfully"
elif docker-compose --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  docker-compose up --abort-on-container-exit --remove-orphans
  docker-compose down --remove-orphans -v
  echo "Docker Compose ran successfully"
else
  echo "No compose command available"
  exit 127
fi
    """,
    user="root",
    timeout=600,
)

print(result.stdout)
sbx.kill()
```
</CodeGroup>
